rootCauseAnalysis.issue: Browser automation testing incompatible with development environment
rootCauseAnalysis.description: Two main issues prevent reliable user testing via browser automation: (1) Vite HMR causes frequent page reloads that break automation flows, and (2) assertions requiring actual validation backend behavior cannot be tested in browser context - they require the Tauri desktop app.

categories.rootCause: Vite HMR causes page reloads; Tauri API errors cause React component unmounting
categories.suggestedFix: Disable HMR for testing, use production build, or implement Tauri WebDriver testing

categories.rootCause: SMTP validation with proxy integration requires Tauri desktop app context with Rust backend
categories.suggestedFix: Use Tauri's native testing framework or manual testing with real Tauri app

successes.description: Per-Domain rotation mode UI works correctly with localStorage fallback. Users can add proxies, select Per-Domain mode, and assign proxies to Gmail, Yahoo, Hotmail domains via dropdown menus. Assignments persist correctly to localStorage.
